name: harness-tuner
description: Meta-plugin: optimize the Claude Code harness for a project. Reads session transcripts to digest recurring user friction, audits CLAUDE.md / skills / rules / commands / hooks / monitors across the hierarchy, and recommends additions / edits / removals -- never touching the root CLAUDE.md. Hierarchy-aware (parent-but-not-root); uses @ imports for cwd-relative content; for monorepos, can author a per-service summary CLAUDE.md that autoloads when working in that subtree. Four-phase pipeline: /digest -> /audit -> /plan -> /tune. Hard rules: never edits root CLAUDE.md, never edits ~/.claude/, refuses CLAUDE.md changes that exceed 200 lines or path-scoped rule changes that exceed 150 lines, validates @ imports resolve, appends one line to .claude/CHANGELOG.md per applied change.
